maddeler.e:
نتنافس (form VI)
# نَتَنَافَسُ (natanāfasu) /na.ta.naː.fa.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# نَتَنَافَسَ (natanāfasa) /na.ta.naː.fa.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# نَتَنَافَسْ (natanāfas) /na.ta.naː.fas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
